question: Should maintainers review the promised focused repair for the source-checkout postinstall boundary, or assign the bounded fix if that PR does not arrive?
rationale: The bug appears narrowly defined, but the `maintainer` label and an active promise of a related PR mean the immediate owner and landing path require maintainer coordination.

options.title: Review the incoming focused PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and validate that the proposed change skips operator-state migration only for source checkouts.

options.title: Assign a bounded repair
options.body: If no focused PR appears, assign a repair that gates the migration with the existing source-checkout classification and adds regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Review the incoming focused PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and validate that the proposed change skips operator-state migration only for source checkouts.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only discussion participant who explicitly stated that a repair PR is incoming.
